facts.anchor_en: 15 working days of paid annual leave
facts.q_zh: 员工每年有多少天年假？
facts.q_en: How many days of annual leave are employees entitled to?
facts.a_zh: 入职满一年后每个自然年度 15 个工作日带薪年假，需提前 3 个工作日申请。
facts.a_en: 15 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year after one year of service, requested 3 working days in advance.

facts.anchor_zh: 上午 09:30 前通过人事系统提交
facts.q_zh: 请病假需要在什么时间之前提交？
facts.q_en: By what time must sick leave be submitted?
facts.a_zh: 须在当日上午 09:30 前通过人事系统提交；连续超过 2 个工作日需提供医院证明。
facts.a_en: Before 09:30 on the same day; absences over 2 consecutive working days need a medical certificate.

facts.anchor_en: probation period for new employees is 6 months
facts.q_zh: 新员工的试用期是多久？
facts.q_en: How long is the probation period for new employees?
facts.a_zh: 试用期为 6 个月，每季度进行一次绩效回顾。
facts.a_en: 6 months, with a performance review each quarter.

facts.anchor_zh: 行程结束后 30 个自然日内提交报销
facts.anchor_en: within 30 calendar days after the trip ends
facts.q_zh: 差旅报销需要在多久内提交？
facts.q_en: What is the deadline for submitting travel expenses?
facts.a_zh: 行程结束后 30 个自然日内提交，逾期需部门负责人书面说明。
facts.a_en: Within 30 calendar days after the trip ends; late submissions need written justification.

facts.q_zh: 加班折算的调休有效期是多久？
facts.q_en: How long is overtime time-off-in-lieu valid?
facts.a_zh: 调休有效期为 90 天，逾期作废且不折现。
facts.a_en: 90 days; unused balances expire and are not cashed out.

facts.anchor_zh: 每周最多可申请 2 天远程办公
facts.anchor_en: up to 2 remote working days per week
facts.q_zh: 每周可以远程办公几天？
facts.q_en: How many remote working days are allowed per week?
facts.a_zh: 每周最多 2 天，需提前一个工作日审批，核心会议日不得远程。
facts.a_en: Up to 2 days per week, approved one working day in advance; core meeting days are on-site.

facts.anchor_zh: 提前 30 天提交书面通知
facts.q_zh: 离职需要提前多久通知公司？
facts.q_en: How much notice is required for resignation?
facts.a_zh: 提前 30 天提交书面通知，并完成交接与资产归还。
facts.a_en: 30 days written notice, plus handover and asset return.

facts.q_zh: 员工的年度培训预算是多少？
facts.q_en: What is the annual training budget per employee?
facts.a_zh: 每人每自然年度 8000 元，用于外部课程与认证考试，需事先审批。
facts.a_en: CNY 8000 per employee per calendar year for external courses and certifications, subject to prior approval.

facts.anchor_zh: 价值超过 200 元的礼品
facts.q_zh: 收受礼品的价值上限是多少？
facts.q_en: What is the value limit for accepting gifts?
facts.a_zh: 不得超过 200 元，超限礼品须登记并上交合规部门。
facts.a_en: CNY 200; items above the limit must be registered and surrendered to Compliance.

facts.anchor_zh: 5 个工作日内通过合规系统申报
facts.anchor_en: within 5 working days of becoming aware
facts.q_zh: 发现利益冲突后需要在多久内申报？
facts.q_en: How soon must a conflict of interest be declared?
facts.a_zh: 在知悉后的 5 个工作日内通过合规系统申报。
facts.a_en: Within 5 working days of becoming aware, via the compliance system.

facts.q_zh: 公司数据分为几个等级？
facts.q_en: How many data classification levels does the company use?
facts.a_zh: 分为 4 级：公开、内部、机密、绝密；机密及以上不得存于个人设备。
facts.a_en: 4 levels: Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted; Confidential and above must not be stored on personal devices.

facts.q_zh: 财报前的禁止交易窗口有多长？
facts.q_en: How long is the trading blackout before earnings?
facts.a_zh: 财报发布前 30 天至发布后 2 个交易日内禁止交易。
facts.a_en: From 30 days before the release until 2 trading days after.

facts.q_zh: 合规举报的渠道有哪些？
facts.q_en: What channels are available for compliance reporting?
facts.a_zh: 可通过合规邮箱或热线举报，支持实名与匿名，受理后 10 个工作日内反馈。
facts.a_en: Compliance mailbox or hotline, anonymous reporting supported, with feedback within 10 working days.

facts.q_zh: 合规审计记录需要保存多久？
facts.q_en: How long must compliance audit records be retained?
facts.a_zh: 至少保存 7 年，到期销毁需合规负责人与法务共同审批。
facts.a_en: At least 7 years; destruction requires joint approval by Compliance Head and Legal.

facts.anchor_zh: 签约前必须完成第三方尽职调查
facts.q_zh: 第三方尽调需要在什么时候完成？
facts.q_en: When must third-party due diligence be completed?
facts.a_zh: 必须在签约前完成；高风险主体还需提交合规委员会审议。
facts.a_en: Before signing; high-risk entities also require Compliance Committee review.

facts.anchor_zh: 不少于 2 小时的反腐败
facts.q_zh: 每年的反腐培训要求多少小时？
facts.q_en: How many hours of anti-corruption training are required annually?
facts.a_zh: 每年不少于 2 小时，未完成者不得参与晋升评审。
facts.a_en: At least 2 hours per year; completion is required for promotion review.

facts.q_zh: 接口的速率限制是多少？
facts.q_en: What is the API rate limit?
facts.a_zh: 每个租户 1000 QPS，超出返回 429 并给出重试等待时间。
facts.a_en: 1000 QPS per tenant; exceeding it returns 429 with retry-after.

facts.anchor_zh: 访问令牌有效期为 3600 秒
facts.anchor_en: Access tokens are valid for 3600 seconds
facts.q_zh: 访问令牌的有效期是多久？
facts.q_en: How long is an access token valid?
facts.a_zh: 访问令牌有效期 3600 秒，刷新令牌 14 天。
facts.a_en: Access tokens 3600 seconds; refresh tokens 14 days.

facts.q_zh: 应用日志在线保留多久？
facts.q_en: How long are application logs retained online?
facts.a_zh: 在线保留 180 天，归档保留 2 年，且不得记录明文敏感信息。
facts.a_en: 180 days online, 2 years archived, with no plaintext sensitive data.

facts.anchor_zh: 静态存储采用 AES-256 加密
facts.q_zh: 数据传输和存储分别用什么加密标准？
facts.q_en: Which encryption standards are used for data at rest and in transit?
facts.a_zh: 静态存储 AES-256，传输 TLS 1.3，禁用 TLS 1.0/1.1。
facts.a_en: AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit; TLS 1.0/1.1 are prohibited.

facts.anchor_zh: 默认每页返回 20 条记录
facts.q_zh: 列表接口默认每页返回多少条？
facts.q_en: How many records does a list endpoint return per page by default?
facts.a_zh: 默认 20 条，单页最大 200 条。
facts.a_en: 20 by default, maximum 200 per page.

facts.anchor_en: times out synchronous requests after 30 seconds
facts.q_zh: API 网关的超时时间是多少？
facts.q_en: What is the API gateway timeout?
facts.a_zh: 同步请求 30 秒，超时返回 504，批处理需改用异步接口。
facts.a_en: 30 seconds for synchronous requests, returning 504; batch work must use the async API.

facts.q_zh: 如何指定接口版本？
facts.q_en: How is the API version specified?
facts.a_zh: 通过请求头 X-API-Version 指定，默认 v2，旧版本有 12 个月过渡期。
facts.a_en: Via the X-API-Version header, defaulting to v2, with a 12-month transition for deprecated versions.

facts.q_zh: 错误码的格式是什么？
facts.q_en: What is the error code format?
facts.a_zh: 5 位数字，前两位为服务域，后三位为具体错误，响应需含 trace_id。
facts.a_en: 5 digits: two for the service domain, three for the specific error, with trace_id in the response.

facts.q_zh: 核心交易数据使用什么数据库？
facts.q_en: Which database stores core transactional data?
facts.a_zh: PostgreSQL 16 主从集群，同步复制，读请求路由至只读副本。
facts.a_en: A PostgreSQL 16 primary-replica cluster with synchronous replication; reads go to replicas.

facts.q_zh: 消息队列的副本配置是怎样的？
facts.q_en: What replication is configured for the message queue?
facts.a_zh: Kafka 关键主题配置 3 副本与 acks=all。
facts.a_en: Kafka critical topics use 3 replicas with acks=all.

facts.q_zh: 缓存集群有多少个节点？
facts.q_en: How many nodes are in the cache cluster?
facts.a_zh: 6 节点 Redis 集群，一致性哈希分片，热点数据 5 分钟过期。
facts.a_en: A 6-node Redis cluster with consistent hashing; hot data expires in 5 minutes.

facts.anchor_zh: 统一网关 Kong 接入
facts.q_zh: 外部流量通过什么网关接入？
facts.q_en: Which gateway handles external traffic?
facts.a_zh: 统一网关 Kong，负责认证、限流、灰度路由与访问日志。
facts.a_en: The unified Kong gateway, handling authentication, rate limiting, canary routing and access logging.

facts.q_zh: 服务部署在几个可用区？
facts.q_en: How many availability zones are services deployed across?
facts.a_zh: 跨 3 个可用区，每服务至少 2 个副本并配置反亲和性。
facts.a_en: 3 availability zones, with at least 2 replicas per service and anti-affinity.

facts.q_zh: 可观测体系由哪些组件构成？
facts.q_en: Which components make up the observability stack?
facts.a_zh: Prometheus 采集指标、Loki 汇聚日志、Tempo 存储链路追踪，通过 trace_id 关联。
facts.a_en: Prometheus for metrics, Loki for logs, Tempo for traces, correlated by trace_id.

facts.anchor_zh: 全量备份并保留 35 天
facts.q_zh: 数据库备份保留多久？
facts.q_en: How long are database backups retained?
facts.a_zh: 每日全量备份保留 35 天，每 6 小时增量备份，季度恢复演练。
facts.a_en: Daily full backups retained 35 days, incremental every 6 hours, quarterly restore drills.

facts.anchor_en: availability target for core services is 99.95%
facts.q_zh: 核心服务的可用性目标是多少？
facts.q_en: What is the availability target for core services?
facts.a_zh: 99.95%，月度不可用时间预算约 21 分钟。
facts.a_en: 99.95%, about 21 minutes of monthly unavailability budget.
